timeout_fetch_all_nodes.description: Maximum time in seconds munin-update may take to get updates from all nodes. When using the munin protocol to connect to a node, this should not be set higher than 240.

timeout_fetch_one_node.description: Maximum amount of time in seconds munin-update may work on a single node. Effectively limited by timeout_fetch_all_nodes.

host_name.description: Name of the monitored host as it appears in the Munin host tree (the [section] header).

host_address.description: Network address (IP or hostname) Munin uses to contact the monitored node.

use_node_name.description: Whether to use the node's own reported name instead of the section name ('yes' or 'no').
